about: Model verdicts on source against tree for hse-l5 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The group heading printed above the three right-hand columns of Table 1 is not in the column names; the values still sit in the right columns.
findings.evidence: source: "Duty for the protection of:" / tree: "Employees", "Other people on the premises", "Other people likely to be affected by the work"

findings.problem: The heading for Principle (f) is read as body text at the end of paragraph 111, which belongs to Principle (e), so paragraphs 112 and 113 lose their principle heading.
findings.evidence: source: heading "Principle (f): Check and review regularly all elements of control measures for their continuing effectiveness" / tree: "may provide no protection when it fails. Principle (f): Check and review regularly"

findings.problem: The heading for Principle (g) is read as body text at the end of paragraph 113, which belongs to Principle (f), so paragraphs 114 to 116 lose their principle heading.
findings.evidence: source: heading "Principle (g): Inform and train all employees on the hazards and risks" / tree: "rely on routine human behaviour. Principle (g): Inform and train all employees"

findings.problem: The small italic sub-headings are placed at the same level as the larger heading above them, so paragraphs 150 to 152 are not under 'Adequate control of exposure by routes other than inhalation'.
findings.evidence: source: "Adequate control of exposure by routes other than inhalation" then "Exposure via the skin (or mucous membranes or eyes)" / tree: "Regulation 7 ... > Exposure via the skin (or mucous membranes or eyes)"

findings.problem: The footnote marker 8 is run into the title of the publication in paragraph 151.
findings.evidence: source: "Managing skin exposure risks at work" with superscript 8 / tree: "Managing skin exposure risks at work8 provides further guidance"

findings.problem: The cross-reference heading "Regulation 2(1)" printed above the list is run into the body text in front of the first list entry.
findings.evidence: source: "Regulation 2(1)" (own line, bold) then "Aflatoxins." / tree: "Regulation 2(1) Aflatoxins. Arsenic."

findings.problem: The header row "Column 1 / Column 2" is not in the column names, though a cell refers to "Column 1".
findings.evidence: source: "Column 1 Description of substance", "Column 2 Purpose for which the substance is prohibited" / tree: "Description of substance", "Purpose for which the substance is prohibited"

findings.problem: The item number has no column of its own and is joined to the substance name, so item 1 reads like part of the chemical name.
findings.evidence: source: "1" | "2-naphthylamine; benzidine;" / tree: "1 2-naphthylamine; benzidine; 4-aminodiphenyl;"

findings.problem: The label "Regulation 4(1)" printed above the table is joined to the start of the definitions text, which is not on this page.
findings.evidence: source: "Regulation 4(1)" / tree: "Regulation 4(1) In this Schedule – “aerosol dispenser” means"

findings.problem: The header labels "Column 1" and "Column 2" are not in the table's columns, though a cell in row 1 refers to "Column 1 of this item".
findings.evidence: source: "Column 1 / Description of substance", "Column 2 / Purpose for which the substance is prohibited" / tree: "Description of substance", "Purpose for which the substance is prohibited"

findings.problem: The item numbers have no column of their own and are joined to the substance text, so item 1 reads like part of the chemical name.
findings.evidence: source: "1" | "2-naphthylamine; benzidine;" / tree: "1 2-naphthylamine; benzidine; 4-aminodiphenyl;"

findings.problem: The cross-reference heading "Regulation 4(1)" is run into the body text in front of the definitions.
findings.evidence: source: "Regulation 4(1)" (own line above the table) / tree: "Regulation 4(1) In this Schedule – “aerosol dispenser” means"

findings.problem: Guidance paragraph 309, printed in its own 'Guidance Schedule 2A' box, is merged into the Schedule 2A regulation text and carries the status 'regulation'.
findings.evidence: source: "Guidance Schedule 2A 309 Further information on the principles of good practice" / tree: "...overall risk to health and safety. 309 Further information on the principles"

findings.problem: The numbered paragraph headings 4 and 5 are read as body text, and paragraphs 4, 5 and 6 of the Schedule are merged into one text section.
findings.evidence: source: heading "4 List of employees exposed to certain biological agents", heading "5 Notification of the use of biological agents" / tree: "...relates to him personally. 5 Notification of the use of biological agents (1) Subject to"

findings.problem: The footnote (a) printed at the top of the page is placed after the paragraph 4 to 6 text in the tree.
findings.evidence: source: "(a) Words substituted subject to transitional provisions as specified by SI 2008/960 Schedule 2, paragraph 11" printed above "4 List of employees"

findings.problem: The margin shows this page is in Schedule 3, but the heading paths of Part I and Part II start at the Part and do not name Schedule 3.
findings.evidence: source: "Schedule 3" / tree: "PART II Containment measures for health and veterinary care facilities, laboratories and animal rooms"

findings.problem: Paragraph 6 is split in two sections in the middle of its list, so item (c) of sub-paragraph (2) starts a new section.
findings.evidence: tree: "(c) the biological agent is or is suspected of being present in a human patient or animal"

findings.problem: The group heading 'Containment levels' over the three level columns is lost, so the grid columns are named only 2, 3 and 4.
findings.evidence: source: "Containment measures | Containment levels | 2 | 3 | 4" / tree: columns "Containment measures", "2", "3", "4"

findings.problem: Paragraph 6(2) is split across two text sections, with item (c) starting a new section apart from items (a) and (b).
findings.evidence: tree: one section ends "solely for the purpose of disposal; or" and the next starts "(c) the biological agent is or is suspected of being present"

findings.problem: The margin shows this table is in Schedule 3, but its heading path starts at Part II and does not name Schedule 3.
findings.evidence: source: "Schedule 3" / tree: "PART II Containment measures for health and veterinary care facilities, laboratories and animal rooms > Table"

findings.problem: The group heading 'Containment levels' over the three level columns is lost, so the grid columns are named only 2, 3 and 4.
findings.evidence: source: "Containment measures | Containment levels | 2 | 3 | 4" / tree: columns "Containment measures", "2", "3", "4"

findings.problem: The group heading 'Containment levels' over the three level columns is lost, so the grid columns are named only 2, 3 and 4.
findings.evidence: source: "Containment measures | Containment levels | 2 | 3 | 4" / tree: columns "Containment measures", "2", "3", "4"

findings.problem: The margin shows Part III is in Schedule 3, but its heading path starts at the Part and does not name Schedule 3.
findings.evidence: source: "Schedule 3" / tree: "PART III Containment measures for industrial processes"

findings.problem: The biohazard sign picture that Part IV says is 'shown below' is on this page but the tree has no figure for it, so the required form of the sign is lost.
findings.evidence: source: "The biohazard sign required by regulation 7(6)(a) shall be in the form shown below –" followed by a yellow triangle with the black biohazard symbol / tree: no figure

findings.problem: The biohazard sign picture, which is the form the rule requires, has no figure in the tree; only the sentence that points to it is kept.
findings.evidence: source: "shall be in the form shown below –" followed by the yellow triangle biohazard sign / tree: no figure

findings.problem: The margin shows Part III and Part IV are in Schedule 3, but their heading paths start at the Part and do not name Schedule 3.
findings.evidence: source: "Schedule 3" / tree: "PART IV Biohazard sign > Text"

findings.problem: The biohazard sign that Part IV says is 'shown below' is printed on the page but the tree holds no figure for it.
findings.evidence: source: "shall be in the form shown below –" followed by the yellow and black triangular biohazard sign / tree: no figure

findings.problem: The group heading above the three level columns is not in the column names, so the columns are only called 2, 3 and 4.
findings.evidence: source: "Containment levels" over "2 3 4" / tree: columns "2", "3", "4"

findings.problem: The footnote (a) under the Schedule 5 table is printed once but the tree holds it twice, and one copy sits under Part I of Schedule 3 as a section from page 83.
findings.evidence: source: "(a) Words substituted subject to transitional provisions as specified by SI 2008/960 Schedule 2" / tree: same text also under "PART I Provisions of general application to biological agents > Text"
